verdicts.text: 33220A POL reads NORM: NORM makes the Sync's rising edge mean light ON, so extraction would happen during illumination
331 not wired: the run pauses at each of the 2 temperatures (250-280 K) for a manual set; GPIB0::7::INSTR is not answering
trigger_sweep = AUTO on 4 scans: the scope sweeps without a trigger, so a loose Sync cable gives untriggered noise that subtracts to a plausible charge
no calibration factor: intensity is recorded in watts at the meter, not as irradiance at the sample (4 readers)
